tree: Track trends, analyze customer sentiment and discover what your customers love — and what needs improvement. Noxtill's Review Analytics gives you the data to make smarter decisions and grow your business.
Get in-depth insights from your customer reviews across all platforms.
Monitor ratings, review volume and trends over time.
Understand what customers feel about your business.
Discover common themes and feedback patterns.
Turn feedback into opportunities for growth.
Get detailed reports to share with your team.
DEEP INSIGHTS FOR A STRONGER BUSINESS
Noxtill analyzes your reviews using AI to identify key topics, sentiment and trends so you can improve customer experience and make data-driven decisions.
Get unified analytics from all your review platforms in one place.
Make Smarter Decisions with Review Analytics
Understand your customers better, improve your service and build a stronger reputation with Noxtill.
How Review Analytics works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a business analyze review trends and customer sentiment?

Bring reviews from every channel into Noxtill and track average rating, review volume and sentiment over time. The customer review analysis tool highlights what customers praise and what they complain about, including Google review analytics for businesses.
How does Review Analytics software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

It turns scattered reviews into decisions about service, staff and products. When comparing review sentiment analysis software, a reputation analytics dashboard or a customer feedback analytics platform, check channel coverage, sentiment views, trend reports and exports.
